en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Abi’l Khattab narrated to us from al-Hakam b. Miskin al-Thaqai from Abi’l `Ala’ al-Khaffaf from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as). He said:
He who prays Maghrib and follows it up by praying two units, without speaking in between, shall be among the elect (`iliyyin). If he prays four units, he shall have an accepted Hajj recorded for him.
